name: PHYRE-B within-template fold 0 (2 tasks per template)

assignment.task: Official PHYRE single-ball tier: place one red ball so that, after the physics simulation, the green object touches a blue or purple object. Up to 100 valid attempts per task; fewer attempts score higher (AUCCESS).
assignment.observation: The official initial scene image, then after each attempt the official status (SOLVED / NOT_SOLVED / INVALID_INPUT) with two rollout frames.

actions.x: ball centre x in [0,1] from the left edge
actions.y: ball centre y in [0,1] from the bottom edge

assignment.evaluation: Official PHYRE: solved or not within 100 valid attempts; AUCCESS over attempts.

contract: One ball placement (x, y, radius, each in [0,1]) per turn.

player.invalidResponses: H0 used structured output (one schema-valid submit_action per response); a refusal or a response without an action was retried with the same request, without a reprompt.
